what: A second copy of the screen-fixed frame (border, vertical nav, vertical text) is layered on top, cut to just the part overlapping dark sections and color-inverted — while the light frame passes a dark photo section, only that part appears as a white frame

options.zone: Selector of the sections to invert, default [data-invert-zone] — if there are several, all are watched
options.--fx-invert: Filter for the overlaid copy (via style), default invert(1)

use: <nav class="frame" data-fx="overlap-invert" style="position: fixed; inset: 10px">…</nav> … <section data-invert-zone>Dark Section</section>

from.where: shared.js frame clone (.g-frame--invert — filter invert(1), only the rectangle overlapping the event range [data-invert-frame] gets clip-path inset)

note: The duplicated set is hidden from screen readers and the keyboard (aria-hidden · tabindex -1 · inert). The frame only makes sense when it stays attached to the screen (fixed · sticky). The clipping is measured again on scroll, resize and section resize
